title: InBharat Audio Capability Manifest v1
description: Declares what an engine/model pack can genuinely do. Capability is evidence, not filenames: a field may only be asserted when the recorded evidence level supports it.

provider.description: Owning provider id, e.g. audiocpp, ai4bharat, sarvam, reference.

languages.description: BCP-47 codes the pack has evidence for. An empty array means language-agnostic.

code_mix.description: True only with code-mix benchmark evidence.

streaming.description: Honest streaming class. 'framework-chunking' and 'pseudo-streaming' must not be marketed as true streaming.

ram_mb.description: Measured peak RSS at inference, not a guess.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the primary model artifact.

validated.description: Per-platform evidence. A platform may only be true after inference has actually run on it; a cross-build is never 'true'.

evidence_level.description: Highest evidence level achieved. Android is only complete at physical-device-tested; a loader/probe success is never an inference claim.
